canaries.name: drop_zero_prefix
canaries.note: Presented as dropping a redundant assign() since leading zeroes 'encode to nothing'; leading zero bytes no longer produce '1' digits, so every address with a zero version byte (P2PKH mainnet) encodes wrongly.

canaries.name: long_input_no_trailing_ws
canaries.note: Adds a 'fast path' for long inputs (over 120 characters) that skips the trailing-whitespace scan; long strings with trailing whitespace are now rejected instead of accepted. Upstream and property tests only pad short strings with whitespace.

canaries.name: full_sweep
canaries.note: Presented as removing a data-dependent branch from the inner loop so it vectorises; it now sweeps the whole digit buffer for every input byte instead of only the digits used so far, which is more work.

candidates.name: encode_limbs
candidates.note: EncodeBase58 keeps the value in little-endian base-58^5 limbs (uint32) and folds three input bytes into it per pass (limb * 2^24 + carry fits in 64 bits), then expands each limb into five digits, instead of one byte per pass over a one-digit-per-byte buffer.

candidates.name: decode_limbs
candidates.note: DecodeBase58 keeps the value in little-endian 32-bit limbs and folds five digits into it per pass (58^5 < 2^32), checking max_ret_len after every pass (the byte length only grows, so the accept/reject decision is unchanged), instead of one digit per pass over a one-byte-per-element buffer.
